idea: Persistent character/vehicle sprites ride over a seamless or loopable moving road plate, with blur, lighting and weather layers creating convincing motion without generated video.

composition.notes: Prefer a horizontally repeatable or long plate; blur and slight scale hide seams.
Hold position or add tiny vertical/rotational oscillation.
Swap semantic poses such as driving, leaning_close, looking_over, singing.
Optional blurred poles, guardrails, rain, branches or light streaks sell speed.
Headlights, neon, moonlight or passing street lamps can pulse independently.

reuse: One generated sprite atlas plus one repeatable road plate can support many visually distinct shots across a song.
avoid: perfectly static vehicle with no secondary motion
regenerating the whole scene for every shot
